title: Construct Snippets
summary: Construct Snippets (WIP) is an open source library of useful functions and other code snippets for the HTML5 game engine Construct 3. Built with comprehensive user validation and session security with HttpOnly cookies. Supports creation and viewing of snippets.

title: Portfolio
summary: After going through various websites over the years, I wanted a single location to put all my content. This site was built with Svelte and served as a personal capstone project in front-end development.

title: React Ticket Tracker
summary: React Ticket Tracker is a fullstack task tracker built with React and state management via Redux. Can be used for bugs, tickets, and project management. Supports posting and updating tasks, timestamps, tasks IDs, descriptions, severity, and status.
